title_en: Zhang Yanhua v. Linyi County Annals Compilation Committee et al. — copyright infringement dispute

full_text_en:
Zhang Yanhua v. Linyi County Local Gazetteer Compilation Committee, et al. — copyright dispute

Plaintiff: Zhang Yanhua, a retired cadre from Beijing Township, Linyi County, Shanxi Province.

Agent ad litem: Liu Hongzhi, legal worker at Yuncheng Legal Service Center, Shanxi Province.

Agent ad litem: Cao Min, lawyer at Yuncheng Second Law Firm.

Defendant: Linyi County Local Gazetteer Compilation Committee, Shanxi Province.

Legal representative: Liu Zhenlong, Director.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Wanrong, Deputy Director of Linyi County Local Gazetteer Office, Shanxi Province.

Agent ad litem: Jing Aiping, lawyer at Linyi County Law Firm, Shanxi Province.

Defendant: Ning Xinjie, former Deputy Director of Linyi County Local Gazetteer Office, retired cadre.

Plaintiff Zhang Yanhua filed a lawsuit with the Yuncheng Intermediate People's Court of Shanxi Province against defendants Linyi County Local Gazetteer Compilation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the Compilation Committee) and Ning Xinjie over a copyright dispute.

The plaintiff alleged: The book *Linyi County Gazetteer* edited and published by the defendant Compilation Committee used approximately 100,000 characters of my works, including the use of my initial draft of the dialect gazetteer, which was not carefully proofread, resulting in over 140 errors. At the direction of the defendant Ning Xinjie, the Compilation Committee used these works without giving me attribution or paying me royalties, thereby infringing my copyright. I request an order that the two defendants cease the infringement, correct the errors, make a public apology in relevant newspapers, and compensate me RMB 28,000 for my royalties, travel expenses incurred in pursuing the infringement, and lost work time.

The defendant Compilation Committee argued: *Linyi County Gazetteer* is the crystallization of collective wisdom, and its copyright belongs to the defendant. There is no individual work in it, and therefore there is no act infringing any individual's copyright.

The defendant Ning Xinjie argued: The copyright of *Linyi County Gazetteer* belongs to the Compilation Committee, whose legal representative is Liu Zhenlong. As a natural person, the defendant should not bear any liability.

The Yuncheng Intermediate People's Court found the following facts upon trial:

From June 1983 to October 1985, the plaintiff Zhang Yanhua was seconded to work at the Linyi County Gazetteer Office, a subordinate unit of the defendant Compilation Committee. During this period, at the direction of the defendant Compilation Committee, Zhang Yanhua edited the book *Linyi County Place Name Gazetteer*. The book was published in 1985, and works such as the "Table of Administrative Divisions and Their Evolution," "Investigation of Ancient Place Names," and "The Battle of Linghu in the Spring and Autumn Period" were created by Zhang Yanhua. During his work at the Gazetteer Office, Zhang Yanhua also collected and compiled "The Story of Wang Gan" through village interviews.

*Linyi County Gazetteer* is a local gazetteer compiled by the defendant Compilation Committee under the arrangement of the Linyi County Party Committee and County Government, with the participation of hundreds of people and over 70 units, taking 12 years to complete. The book totals approximately 1.2 million characters, consisting of nine specialized gazetteers, including the "Population Gazetteer," "Economic Gazetteer," "Social Gazetteer," and "Figures Gazetteer," as well as three parts: "Major Events," "Appendix," and "Gazetteer Supplementary." Each specialized gazetteer is arranged by chapter and section. The book was officially published in 1993, with a first print run of 3,000 copies.

*Linyi County Gazetteer* used approximately 1,800 characters of "The Story of Wang Gan" collected and compiled by the plaintiff Zhang Yanhua, and also used about 20,000 characters from the "Table of Administrative Divisions and Their Evolution," "Investigation of Ancient Place Names," and "The Battle of Linghu in the Spring and Autumn Period" in *Linyi County Place Name Gazetteer* edited by Zhang Yanhua. In 1991, after Zhang Yanhua was transferred to a new work unit, the responsible person of the defendant Compilation Committee orally commissioned Zhang Yanhua to provide some initial drafts for *Linyi County Gazetteer*. To fulfill the commission, Zhang Yanhua not only wrote some initial drafts but also provided the Compilation Committee with the original manuscript of his work *Linyi County Dialect Gazetteer*, published in 1989, which contained over 40,000 characters. After revision by the Compilation Committee, the "Population Gazetteer" section of *Linyi County Gazetteer* adopted about 20,000 characters of Zhang Yanhua's initial draft; Chapter 1 "Folk Customs and Practices" of the "Social Gazetteer" used Zhang Yanhua's initial draft to compile content such as folk customs, songs, and proverbs; Chapter 2 "Dialect" of the "Social Gazetteer" adopted about 30,000 characters of Zhang Yanhua's initial draft. Due to careless proofreading, 135 typographical errors appeared in the content adopted from the initial draft of the "Dialect" section.

In the book *Linyi County Gazetteer*, the names of members of the defendant Compilation Committee, members of the Gazetteer Office, and editors were listed at the front, and the back included a postscript, a list of units that provided materials, and biographies of 16 individuals, including chief editors and editors of each specialized gazetteer, under the title "Glimpses of Gazetteer Persons." The plaintiff Zhang Yanhua believed that he was the author of about 100,000 characters of works in *Linyi County Gazetteer*, but his copyright was deprived by the Compilation Committee, so he filed the lawsuit. On October 25, 1995, the Compilation Committee "supplementarily recorded" all those who participated in the gazetteer or provided materials at the back of *Linyi County Gazetteer*, and Zhang Yanhua's name was included.

The Yuncheng Intermediate People's Court held that the overall copyright of *Linyi County Gazetteer* belongs to the defendant Compilation Committee. Given that the book is a collaborative work by multiple persons, the authors may separately enjoy copyright over their independently created works and enjoy the right of attribution over works made for hire. The plaintiff Zhang Yanhua's copyright was not fully protected, and responsibility should be borne by the defendant Compilation Committee, unrelated to the defendant Ning Xinjie. Accordingly, on August 19, 1997, the court rendered the following judgment:

1. The plaintiff Zhang Yanhua enjoys the right of attribution over the following works in *Linyi County Gazetteer*: the "Population Gazetteer" and parts of Chapter 1 "Folk Customs and Practices" of the "Social Gazetteer," specifically the sections "Weddings, Funerals, Celebrations, and Sacrifices" and "Bad Habits and Taboos," Chapter 2 "Marriage and Family," Chapter 3 "Dialect," and Chapter 4 "Common Sayings," as well as the works "Investigation of Ancient Place Names," "Table of Administrative Divisions and Their Evolution," "The Battle of Linghu in the Spring and Autumn Period," and "The Story of Wang Gan." When *Linyi County Gazetteer* is reprinted, Zhang Yanhua's name shall be attributed in the aforementioned works.

2. When *Linyi County Gazetteer* is reprinted, the defendant Compilation Committee shall correct the 135 errors in Chapter 3 "Dialect."

3. The defendant Compilation Committee shall apologize to the plaintiff Zhang Yanhua in *Shanxi Daily* and *Guangming Daily*.

4. The defendant Compilation Committee shall pay the plaintiff Zhang Yanhua RMB 10,000 as remuneration and compensate Zhang Yanhua for economic losses of RMB 15,000.

The defendant Compilation Committee appealed the first-instance judgment to the Shanxi High People's Court. The grounds were: (1) *Linyi County Gazetteer* is an official gazetteer, a unitary work that cannot be divided and can only be attributed to the Compilation Committee. The appellee Zhang Yanhua provided materials, not works, and has already received a fee for materials. The correspondence between certain chapters in the gazetteer and the materials provided by Zhang Yanhua is due to objective historical facts. (2) The "Dialect" section of the "Social Gazetteer" was reviewed by experts, and there is no issue of 135 errors. (3) *Linyi County Gazetteer* has a narrow circulation, and a "supplementary record" has already been made, indicating that Zhang Yanhua did work. The order to apologize in *Shanxi Daily* and *Guangming Daily* is inappropriate. The appellant requested the reversal of the first-instance judgment, dismissal of Zhang Yanhua's claims, and an order that Zhang Yanhua bear the litigation costs of the first and second instances.

Zhang Yanhua responded, requesting the dismissal of the appeal and affirmation of the original judgment.

Upon trial, the Shanxi High People's Court held:

A local gazetteer is a compilation work edited under the leadership of the local government by a compilation committee designated by the local government, with the committee bearing legal responsibility. Although a local gazetteer has the particularity of reflecting the will of the local government compared to other works, it should also be regulated by the Copyright Law of the PRC like other works. Materials are references. The materials provided by the appellee Zhang Yanhua to the appellant Compilation Committee were literary works created through his mental labor, not mere materials.

Article 11 of the Copyright Law provides: "The citizen who creates a work is the author. Where a work is created under the auspices and according to the intention of a legal entity or an entity without legal personality, and the responsibility for the work is borne by such entity, that entity shall be deemed the author." Article 14 provides: "The copyright in a compilation work shall be enjoyed by the compiler, provided that the exercise of such copyright does not infringe the copyright in the pre-existing works." *Linyi County Gazetteer* is a compilation work completed under the auspices of the appellant Compilation Committee, and its overall copyright belongs to the Compilation Committee. The creators of all works compiled in that book enjoy copyright over their respective original works according to law. When exercising its copyright in the compilation work, the Compilation Committee must not infringe the copyright of the original authors.

*Linyi County Place Name Gazetteer* was edited by the appellee Zhang Yanhua during his employment at the Gazetteer Office. The works such as the "Table of Administrative Divisions and Their Evolution," "Investigation of Ancient Place Names," "The Battle of Linghu in the Spring and Autumn Period," and "The Story of Wang Gan" are works made for hire by Zhang Yanhua according to paragraph 2 of Article 16 of the Copyright Law. Zhang Yanhua enjoys the right of attribution, while the other rights in the copyright are enjoyed by the appellant Compilation Committee. Since the copyrights of both *Linyi County Place Name Gazetteer* and *Linyi County Gazetteer* belong to the Compilation Committee, *Linyi County Gazetteer* may use the content of *Linyi County Place Name Gazetteer*, but the Compilation Committee should not only ensure Zhang Yanhua's right of attribution but also pay appropriate remuneration.

*Linyi County Dialect Gazetteer* is an independently created work by the appellee Zhang Yanhua. According to Article 10 of the Copyright Law, Zhang Yanhua enjoys the rights of publication, attribution, revision, integrity of the work, exploitation, and remuneration. The Dialect chapter of the Social Gazetteer in *Linyi County Gazetteer* used most of the content of *Linyi County Dialect Gazetteer*. The appellant Compilation Committee should ensure Zhang Yanhua's enjoyment of these rights. Zhang Yanhua's request to correct the 135 typographical errors in the Dialect chapter of the Social Gazetteer in *Linyi County Gazetteer* is an exercise of his right to protect the integrity of the work, and the Compilation Committee has an obligation to fulfill it.

The other initial drafts that the appellant Compilation Committee orally commissioned the appellee Zhang Yanhua to write for *Linyi County Gazetteer*, due to the unclear commission, belong to Zhang Yanhua under Article 17 of the Copyright Law.

The appellant Compilation Committee, in the "Glimpses of Gazetteer Persons" section of *Linyi County Gazetteer*, provided biographies for the chief editors, deputy chief editors, or editors of each specialized gazetteer but failed to provide a biography for the editor of *Linyi County Place Name Gazetteer*, the appellee Zhang Yanhua, which is manifestly unfair. After Zhang Yanhua filed the lawsuit, the Compilation Committee paid attention and made a "supplementary record" of all those who participated in the gazetteer, which this court acknowledges. Regarding the Compilation Committee's contention that the first-instance order to publish an apology in the newspapers was inappropriate, this court holds that an apology is one of the forms of civil liability provided in Article 45 of the Copyright Law. The first-instance court's order was appropriate under the law, and no grounds for exemption were found on appeal; therefore, this request cannot be supported. The first-instance judgment found the facts clearly and applied the law properly, but the judgment result failed to distinguish between works made for hire and non-works made for hire, leading to an erroneous amount of damages, which should be modified.

In summary, the Shanxi High People's Court, pursuant to Items (1) and (2) of Paragraph 1 of Article 153 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, rendered the following judgment on August 31, 1998:

1. Items 2 and 3 of the first-instance judgment are affirmed.

2. Item 1 of the first-instance judgment is modified as follows: Zhang Yanhua enjoys full copyright over the Dialect section of the Social Gazetteer in *Linyi County Gazetteer*, and enjoys the right of attribution over the "Story of Wang Gan" and the "Population Gazetteer" sections. When *Linyi County Gazetteer* is reprinted, Zhang Yanhua and his works shall be introduced in the "Glimpses of Gazetteer Persons."

3. Item 4 of the first-instance judgment is modified as follows: The Compilation Committee shall pay Zhang Yanhua RMB 2,100 as remuneration and compensate Zhang Yanhua for economic losses of RMB 15,000.

The total litigation costs for the first instance, etc., amount to RMB 1,900, of which the Compilation Committee bears RMB 1,400 and Zhang Yanhua bears RMB 500. The litigation costs for the second instance amount to RMB 1,100, of which the Compilation Committee bears RMB 600 and Zhang Yanhua bears RMB 500.
